# Build the three candidate edit tensors
import numpy as np, torch, json
E = load('model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight').float()
gamma = load('model.language_model.norm.weight').float()
r = E*(1.0+gamma)
wait_id=tok.token_to_id('Wait'); think_id=tok.token_to_id('</think>')

# Recompute dm from the cached fwd_6 activations (same analysis as before)
d='/work/fwd_6'
meta=json.load(open(d+'/meta.json'))
dms=[]
for ti in [0,1]:
    ids=meta['token_ids'][ti]; n=len(ids)
    h=[np.load(d+f'/hidden_L{L}.npy', mmap_mode='r')[ti,:n,:].astype(np.float32) for L in [23,24]]
    act=np.load(d+'/mlp_act_L23.npy', mmap_mode='r')[ti,:n,:].astype(np.float32)
    dn=load('model.language_model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj.weight').float()
    attn_out=torch.from_numpy(h[1])-torch.from_numpy(h[0])-torch.from_numpy(act)@dn.T
    loop=[i for i in range(n-1) if ids[i+1]==wait_id and i>80]
    other=[i for i in range(n-1) if i not in loop]
    dms.append(attn_out[loop].mean(0) - attn_out[other].mean(0))
dm=(dms[0]+dms[1])/2
rT=r[think_id]; rT_hat=rT/rT.norm()
dm_pt=dm-(dm@rT_hat)*rT_hat
d3=(r[wait_id]-r[think_id]); d3=d3/d3.norm()   # E3
d2=dm_pt/dm_pt.norm()                        # E2
d1=dm/dm.norm()                              # E1
print('d2 norm check', d2.norm().item(), 'dm@rT_hat removal ok')

W23 = load('model.language_model.layers.23.self_attn.o_proj.weight').float()  # [1024, 2048]
def ortho(W, dhat, alpha=1.0):
    return W - alpha*torch.outer(dhat, (dhat@W))
E1 = ortho(W23, d1); E2 = ortho(W23, d2); E3 = ortho(W23, d3)
torch.save({'E1':E1,'E2':E2,'E3':E3,'d1':d1,'d2':d2,'d3':d3}, '/work/edit_candidates.pt')
print('saved candidates', E1.shape, E2.shape, E3.shape)
